claim: The google-cloud-speech dependency can go: speech recognition runs on a Gemini transcribe model through google-genai (platform/speech.py), nothing in src, tests or scripts imports google.cloud.speech, and the app would behave the same without it. uv.lock and the stale SDK list at .engine/architecture/architecture-map.md:603 would need updating in the same change.

evidence.detail: pyproject: google-cloud-speech is declared and no module named google_cloud_speech is imported

speech builds a google.genai client. The only imports of google.cloud.speech_v2 in the repository are in the spike probe .engine/artifacts/spikes/voice-stt-2026-10-23/chirp3_probe.py:2, which is outside src
the ADR that chose Gemini transcribe says the google-cloud-speech package is no longer needed

The other four dependency signals are false. google-auth is imported as google.auth (platform/tts.py:167, identity.py:74). google-cloud-storage is imported as google.cloud.storage (storage.py:128). google-genai is imported as google.genai (llm.py:14). jinja2 is needed by fastapi.templating.Jinja2Templates (web/server.py:23). The vulture model_config, validator, settings_customise_sources, route-function and Profile-field signals are pydantic, FastAPI or LLM-schema uses, so they are traps.
